differences: Text A says the card is cast from the graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs (its own mana cost). Text B says to pay {3}{U} and discard rather than paying its mana cost, which replaces the mana cost with a different fixed cost.

Text A exiles the card as part of the cast, so it is exiled whenever it leaves the stack, including if it is countered. Text B exiles it only "as it resolves", so a countered or otherwise non-resolving spell goes to the graveyard in B.
